nameForms.name: Duchy of Bohemia
nameForms.note: The Přemyslid succession held Bohemia as a duchy before the hereditary royal title was secured.
nameForms.noteCn: 普热米斯尔继承线先以公国形式持有波希米亚，1198 年后取得世袭王位。

nameForms.name: Kingdom of Bohemia
nameForms.note: Ottokar I secured the hereditary royal title; after the Přemyslid male line ended in 1306, the crown passed through Habsburg and Gorizia claimants to Luxembourg.
nameForms.noteCn: 奥托卡一世取得世袭王位；普热米斯尔男性直系于 1306 年结束后，王位经哈布斯堡与戈里齐亚继承人过渡至卢森堡。

holders.note: Vratislaus II ruled Bohemia as duke before becoming its first king.
holders.noteCn: 弗拉季斯拉夫二世先以公爵统治波希米亚，后成为其首位国王。

holders.note: First Bohemian king; the royal dignity was not yet hereditary.
holders.noteCn: 首位波希米亚国王；此时王位尚非世袭。

holders.note: Succeeded Vratislaus II.
holders.noteCn: 继承弗拉季斯拉夫二世。

holders.note: First of two interrupted periods as duke.
holders.noteCn: 第一次出任公爵。

holders.note: Brief ducal reign.
holders.noteCn: 短暂出任公爵。

holders.note: First period of rule.
holders.noteCn: 第一次统治时期。

holders.note: Returned to the duchy during the succession struggle.
holders.noteCn: 在继承斗争中复归公爵位。

holders.note: Returned for a second period.
holders.noteCn: 第二次统治时期。

holders.note: Succeeded Vladislaus I.
holders.noteCn: 继承弗拉迪斯拉夫一世。

holders.note: Ruled as duke before receiving the royal dignity.
holders.noteCn: 先以公爵身份统治，后取得王号。

holders.note: The royal title was granted for life in 1158.
holders.noteCn: 1158 年取得终身国王称号。

holders.note: First period of rule.
holders.noteCn: 第一次统治时期。

holders.note: Held the duchy between Frederick's two periods.
holders.noteCn: 在弗里德里希两段统治之间出任公爵。

holders.note: Returned for a second period.
holders.noteCn: 第二次统治时期。

holders.note: Brief successor before the final succession disputes.
holders.noteCn: 在后续继承斗争前短暂继任。

holders.note: Short ducal reign.
holders.noteCn: 短暂出任公爵。

holders.note: First ducal period of Ottokar I.
holders.noteCn: 奥托卡一世第一次出任公爵。

holders.note: Ruled during Ottokar I's displacement.
holders.noteCn: 在奥托卡一世失位期间统治。

holders.note: Yielded the succession to Ottokar I.
holders.noteCn: 将继承权让与奥托卡一世。

holders.note: Second ducal period before securing the hereditary crown.
holders.noteCn: 取得世袭王冠前第二次出任公爵。

holders.note: Secured the hereditary royal title and established the kingdom's durable royal status.
holders.noteCn: 取得世袭王位，确立王国持久的王权地位。

holders.note: Succeeded Ottokar I.
holders.noteCn: 继承奥托卡一世。

holders.note: Powerful Přemyslid king defeated and killed at Marchfeld.
holders.noteCn: 强势的普热米斯尔国王，最终在马赫费尔德战役中战败身亡。

holders.note: Restored Přemyslid power and acquired the Polish crown.
holders.noteCn: 恢复普热米斯尔势力并取得波兰王冠。

holders.note: Last Přemyslid king; his death ended the direct male line.
holders.noteCn: 最后一位普热米斯尔国王；其死亡终结男性直系。

holders.note: Habsburg transition after the Přemyslid line.
holders.noteCn: 普热米斯尔王朝之后的哈布斯堡过渡。

holders.note: Gorizia claimant before the Luxembourg succession.
holders.noteCn: 卢森堡继承前的戈里齐亚继承人。

holders.note: John's marriage to Elisabeth of Bohemia established Luxembourg rule in the kingdom and made him the father of Karl IV.
holders.noteCn: 约翰通过迎娶波希米亚的伊丽莎白建立卢森堡王朝的统治，并成为卡尔四世之父。

holders.note: Karl IV made Prague a political and cultural centre of the empire while ruling Bohemia.
holders.noteCn: 卡尔四世统治期间，布拉格成为帝国的政治与文化中心。

holders.note: Wenceslaus IV, successor of Karl IV.
holders.noteCn: 卡尔四世的继承者瓦茨拉夫四世。

holders.note: Sigismund was the last Luxembourg king of Bohemia; his death ended the dynasty's rule there.
holders.noteCn: 西吉斯蒙德是最后一位卢森堡王朝的波希米亚国王；其去世结束了该王朝在当地的统治。
